mapper.select: SELECT INQUIRY_ID AS inquiryId, MEMBER_ID AS memberId, INQUIRY_TYPE AS inquiryType, TITLE AS title, CONTENT AS content, STATUS AS status, ANSWER AS answer, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, ANSWERED_AT AS answeredAt FROM INQUIRY WHERE INQUIRY_ID = #{inquiryId}
mapper.update: UPDATE INQUIRY SET ANSWER = #{answer}, STATUS = 'ANSWERED', ANSWERED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE INQUIRY_ID = #{inquiryId}
